evidence.shows: Sky.money is the frontend interface for Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO); operated by Skybase International as a non-custodial interface with no control over protocol smart contracts. Governance forum at forum.sky.money, GitHub at github.com/sky-ecosystem, governance voting at vote.sky.money.

Sky Protocol developer docs confirm: GitHub org is https://github.com/sky-ecosystem, canonical chainlog at https://chainlog.sky.money/, governance voting at https://vote.sky.money/, info dashboard at https://info.sky.money. Docs cover USDS, sUSDS, stUSDS, SKY tokens; Vat, Vow, Jug, Pot core contracts; LitePSM, LockStake Engine; governance Chief, DSPause, Spell contracts.

Vat is the core vault engine of DSS storing all vault and Dai/collateral balances. Any module authed against the Vat has full root access. Governance can authorize new modules against the Vat. RWA vault architecture described: MIP21-based vaults use ilk (collateral type) framework within the Vat.

Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO) whitepaper describes RWA vaults implemented under MIP21 framework for interfacing with traditional financial instruments. The Allocation System manages capital deployment into tokenized RWAs. Stars (sub-DAOs) borrow from Sky Protocol to deploy into DeFi protocols and tokenized real-world assets.

protocol_metadata.about: Sky Protocol (formerly MakerDAO) is an Ethereum-based decentralized protocol that allows users to mint USDS (a USD-pegged stablecoin), earn yield via the Sky Savings Rate (sUSDS), and stake SKY governance tokens. The RWA (Real World Asset) vertical within Sky Protocol deploys USDS capital into tokenized real-world assets — including sovereign debt, structured credit, and other off-chain financial instruments — through MIP21-based vault structures and an Allocation System managed by Sky sub-DAOs (Stars). Governance over RWA allocations is exercised by SKY tokenholders via the Chief/DSPause/Spell governance pipeline with an 18-hour timelock delay.
